question: Should summarize officially support Loom share/embed URLs in core through the generic yt-dlp pipeline, including the accompanying Chrome/daemon and Firecrawl special cases?
rationale: Loom is not part of the current documented input contract, and this PR adds a new supported host plus substantial host-specific policy across several shared surfaces without prior maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Sponsor core Loom support
options.body: Accept Loom as an officially supported media host after successful real-provider proof confirms the current implementation.

options.title: Narrow the core change
options.body: Keep only generic media-routing changes that are independently useful and defer broader Chrome, Firecrawl, or host-specific policy.

options.title: Decline official support
options.body: Close the implementation and leave Loom behavior dependent on unsupported generic URL handling or external tooling.

recommendation.title: Sponsor core Loom support
recommendation.body: Accept Loom as an officially supported media host after successful real-provider proof confirms the current implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected extraction and extension architecture traces primarily to Peter Steinberger's current-main work.
